summary_en: DTS completed cancellation of 4,805,900 shares on September 30, 2026, representing 2.93% of issued shares before cancellation. Post-cancellation issued share count stands at 159,149,028 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: DTS completed the cancellation of 4,805,900 shares of its common stock on September 30, 2026, pursuant to a resolution adopted by the board of directors on May 1, 2026 under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancelled shares represented 2.93% of the issued share count (including treasury stock) prior to cancellation. Following the completion, the company's issued share count totaled 159,149,028 shares, with 4,392,014 shares held in treasury as of August 31, 2026.
